object_description: staggered volume with a six-storey tall house and a two-storey low part
geometry_property: three atriums over the vehicle hall
industrial windows and sheet metal panels
design_condition: the staggered volume stays low towards its neighbours and rises towards the city centre with a tall house, granting the archive a radiance towards the esplanade while the low part turns discreetly inward

positive: Low on the outside it seeks dialogue with its neighbours and accents the city centre with a tall house
The height grading creates a high degree of naturalness and a clever connection between use and urban design
The archive is granted a radiance towards the esplanade
The low part turns discreetly inward according to its needs
As a public building the archive appears attractive and appropriate as the collective memory of the city
Its independent architectural language recalls the industrial history of the site
The entrance and reading hall design enrich the street with the best possible address
Access is provided discreetly at the front for deliveries and staff
The compact vehicle hall impresses with its spatial expansion into the upper floor
Three atriums provide the vehicle hall with zenithal light
Welcome eye contact is enabled between the upper floor and the vehicle hall
The traffic area allows a conflict-free and very good emergency and re-establishment process
The workplaces benefit from a wonderful view over the city
The construction allows opaque facade parts to be opened or made transparent
A generous building and spatial structure ensures a high level of flexibility for current or future uses
A spacious staircase efficiently accesses all floors
Prefabricated finely chiselled concrete parts impress through virtuoso corner solutions and joining
With industrial windows and sheet metal panels they refer to classic industrial architecture
The material-oriented interior creates an extremely beautiful spatial atmosphere
It triggers studio and workshop associations without romantic industrial aesthetics
The prefabricated concrete structure is simple and feasible
The span of the storey-high beams above the vehicle hall is practical and manageable
A very beautiful and successful supporting structure that optimally completes the project idea
The energy and building technology concept is clearly explained and neatly incorporated
The proposal enriches the development area with a high-quality urban building block
negative: The location of the quarantine on the fifth floor is unfavourable
The upper workplaces are somewhat difficult to reach
More spatial quality would be desirable in the corridors, especially regarding daylight
The spacious staircase sometimes leads to conflicts between the different users
Horizontal bracing via the core is possible but the necessary bracing element in one facade is missing
The inherently good economic efficiency is compromised by the chosen facade proposal
The closed lightweight facade inserts do not ideally serve the required climate stability in the archive
